description:
download version 0.21: download

removed speed bonus to nav buoy and range bonus to sensor array
remove nav buoy and sensor array from campaign battles
battle size increased from 100 to 400

added missions:
random battle easy
like the default random battle but bigger and all ship types (except freighter), AI has 30% less fleet points
random battle medium
like the default random battle but bigger and all ship types (except freighter), AI has same fleet points
random battle hard
like the default random battle but bigger and all ship types (except freighter), AI has 30% more fleet points
all random battle
same as random battle hard but also with freighters
random battle factions
each side has ships from only one of the factions, AI has same fleet points
random battle fighters
a few carriers and frigates and many fighters and bombers, AI has same fleet points
variant vs variant
two fleets composed of a single ship type each, the two fleets have the same fleet points
variant vs variant BB
two fleets composed of a single ship type each, the two fleets have the same fleet points. Only battleship class ship are used.
swarm
the player have only one ship, while the AI many smaller ships
swarm figthers
the player have only one ship, while the AI many fighters
